Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

**Analyzing patterns and outputs**

I’m trying to infer a rule here. It looks like I need to demonstrate that horizontal and vertical full lines of 8 separators can be reduced to 2, particularly focusing on the right-side column 24. Observing the input, rows 2 and 7 have all 8 separators, so I need to output those rows. 

There's a dominant test pattern with 6 stripes, suggesting that I should change those rows to 6. It appears I’d need to replace various full lines with consistent colors in this output transformation.

**Evaluating output transformations**

I'm testing to see how full lines of 6 rows correspond to vertical columns, specifically columns 2 and 5, which broadly hold 6 but aren't fully uninterrupted. Column 2 has all 6, and column 5 mostly does too, along with separator rows.

I think I might need to recolor all full lines of 6 to a target color, demonstrating that the output will show 2 instead. It seems like column 24 has all entries as 8, so I'll recolor intersecting full lines to represent this in the output, creating a program that can run input actions in JSON format.
